sources.summary: Promotion: British furniture maker Joint Design Direction has used Autodesk's Fusion software to help expand its offering of homegrown workplace furniture, including a sleep pod that hides a full-size single bed. The company now offers more than 30 products, which customers can personalise at will, all designed and manufactured at its headquarters in Dudley.
